newsitem.title: EGYPT: August is record month for tourism to Egypt.
newsitem.headline: August is record month for tourism to Egypt.

text.p: The number of people visiting Egypt in August broke the record for any month, at 387,000 compared with 354,000 in July and 355,000 in August last year, the cabinet office said in statistics released on Thursday.
The previous record was 366,000, set in August 1994. August is usually a peak month because of the summer holidays in Europe, the main source of tourists to Egypt.
The figures suggested that 1996 as a whole is set to be a record year for tourism, the third largest source of foreign exchange after remittances and visible exports.
In the first eight months of 1996, Egypt had 2.455 million visitors, against 1.960 million in the same period of 1995.
The cabinet office gave no figure for revenue from tourism in August. Revenue is running at more than $3 billion a year.
